title: Spotlight on… Abidjan
summary: This C40 case study describes “Spotlight on… Abidjan,” an urban initiative documented for Abidjan. It is included because it addresses river flood hazards, and it is located in the Global South. intervention.objectives: Governor of Abidjan Robert Mambé discusses the climate crisis impacts facing our cities and the work that must be done to protect residents.
intervention.measures:
In 2022, the city of Abidjan witnessed an intense rainy season, resulting in devastating floods. 
 Governor of Abidjan Robert Mambé discusses the climate crisis impacts facing our cities and the work that must be done to protect residents.
 More From The ‘Spotlight On…’ Series 
 This video was originally produced for the C40 World Mayors Summit in Buenos Aires .
